scope: Approved hosts may reuse these local visual-runtime hooks. They do not establish product, provider, trust, approval, or permission state.

hooks.mount: mount(document) -> { mounted, surfaces, components, refresh, configure, setState, unmount }
hooks.configure: configure({ plate, hue, chroma, toneAnchor, mode, brightness, position, selectiveColor, presence, backgroundPresence, solid, accentHue })
hooks.resolve: resolve(role, state, parent) -> pure immutable plan
hooks.unmount: unmount() -> disconnect observers and pending render timer

hooks.refresh: refresh(immediate = false) coalesces a scene update; true paints a prepared scene immediately
hooks.inspect: inspect() -> scene key, generation, status, scene timings, resource counts
hooks.configureHost: configureHost({worldSelector,excludeSelector,ignoredHostSelector}) -> configured host selectors; use explicitly for legacy hosts
hooks.release: release() -> cancels pending scene and releases sample resources; refresh() can restart

defaults.worldRequirement: exactly one visible world per host view with a direct-child .plate

fallbacks: bounded synchronous PNG encoding when convertToBlob is absent or slow

hooks.resolve: resolve(role, profile, width, height, parentRadius, inset, { edgeFollowing }) -> radius
hooks.stops: stops -> Precise, Crisp, Balanced, Soft, Round

geometry.scope: Border-radius geometry only; parent-radius subtraction is opt-in with edgeFollowing:true and it does not paint material films or persist state.

hooks.create: create({ geometry, onReadout, onPersist, eventTarget }) -> { apply }

cornerController.hostBoundary: eventTarget is an EventTarget for local CustomEvent notification only. The host supplies callbacks for state storage, any atomic/Blackboard postMessage transport, and human-readable demo text; the corner controller does not provide postMessage.

hooks.encode: encode_plate(validated_source_bytes, profile=None) -> lossless plate plus thumbnail bounded to 320×180 by default; plate-profile.json selects the collection’s 1664×936 plates and 640×360 thumbnails

hooks.resolve: resolve(input, depth) -> effective mode, amount and operation

blendController.hostBoundary: Pure module; owns no DOM, storage, transport or product state.

hooks.normalize: normalize(input) -> bounded amount, spread and angle

finishController.hostBoundary: Pure module; owns no DOM, storage, transport or product state.

hooks.resolve: resolve(RGBA pixels, mode) -> ink, overlay, alpha and contrast estimate

contrastController.hostBoundary: Pure module; owns no DOM, storage, transport or product state. Contrast sampling is an estimate, not a full accessibility certification.

rootAppearanceState.data-selective: true when selective background color is enabled
rootAppearanceState.data-solid: true when the host requests the solid/readability fallback

semanticAttributes.data-volume-world: exactly one visible sampling world per host view
semanticAttributes.data-volume-role: atmosphere, context, workplane, reading, editor, control, primary, source-item, or overlay
semanticAttributes.data-volume-state: resting, hover, focus, pressed, active, selected, inset, recessed, raised, floating, disabled, or error
semanticAttributes.data-volume-purpose: optional authored purpose; decision-surface/review-action can select explicit depth

hostMust: retain readable content in normal DOM
load core modules in dependency order
call unmount before removing the host document
hostMay: use an approved local plate or data SVG
hostMustNot: infer meaning from sibling or column order
use proposal/demo IDs as integration hooks
put readable content into raster substrates
treat depth as permission or approval
send provider/business claims from this runtime

rowMajorBlur.note: boxBlur traverses contiguous rows for horizontal and vertical passes with explicit channel sums.

cacheAndDomReuse.note: resolve plans, decoded images, blurred depth buffers, encoded base substrate, film nodes, and scene keys are reused within bounded ownership.

encodedSubstrate.note: one encoded base substrate is retained for the same source/size/exposure key; it remains separate from readable DOM.

boundedPngPolicy.note: Maximum one outstanding encode;250ms asynchronous deadline, same-pixel synchronous fallback, recovery after successful settlement within1000ms; stale generations discarded.

cornerOnlyPath.note: corner profile changes update border-radius geometry without rebuilding material samples.

assetLoading.note: same-origin local plate URLs or data SVGs are loaded through a three-entry decoded-image cache; approved hosts should avoid remote or unbounded data sources.

optionalHostModules.fonts: design-system/tokens.css loads bundled licensed fonts; keep proposal/delivery-assets alongside runtime or rewrite URLs in the host bundle.
